bugs.summary: __setstate__ now assumes state is a dict and checks `name in state`. For old pickles, whose state is a tuple of values, this tests attribute names against the tuple's values, so no attributes are set.
bugs.trigger: Unpickle a slotted attrs instance pickled with attrs < 22.2.0 (state is a tuple): no attribute is set and accessing one raises AttributeError (upstream fix #1085 accepts tuples).

related_valid: __getstate__ now returns a dict, so pickles written by the new version cannot be read by older attrs versions.
